entries.speaker: Alibaba
entries.en: It has been two weeks.

entries.speaker: Alibaba
entries.en: How much longer are you[n]going to make me wait?
A while more.
Just a bit longer.

entries.speaker: Alibaba
entries.en: Are you really going to[n]uphold your promise?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Course we are.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We need your help, after all.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Otherwise we wouldn't be able[n]to do anything about Medjed.
entries.uk: Інакше ми нічого не вдіємо[n]з Меджедом.

entries.speaker: Alibaba
entries.en: Then hurry it up.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Mind if I cut in?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: There's something I'd[n]like to ask you.
entries.uk: Я хотіла б дещо[n]в тебе спитати.

entries.speaker: Alibaba
entries.en: What is it?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: There have been information[n]leaks from various high-profile[n]companies lately...
entries.uk: Останнім часом із кількох[n]відомих компаній стався[n]витік даних...

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Are those Medjed's doing?

entries.speaker: Alibaba
entries.en: Who knows?

entries.speaker: Alibaba
entries.en: I don't care about that stuff.

entries.speaker: Alibaba
entries.en: They might be behind it,[n]or they might not.
entries.uk: Може, це вони,[n]а може, й ні.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Is it possible for you[n]to look into that?
entries.uk: А чи можливо для тебе[n]це з'ясувати?

entries.speaker: Alibaba
entries.en: Possible? It's easy! Who[n]do you think I am?
entries.uk: Можливо? Та це легко![n]За кого ви мене маєте?

entries.speaker: Alibaba
entries.en: Hold on, I'm not falling[n]for that trick.
entries.uk: Стривайте, на цей трюк[n]я не куплюся.

entries.speaker: Alibaba
entries.en: First, you keep your promise.

entries.speaker: Alibaba
entries.en: Do so, and I'll lend you my help.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Medjed hasn't done anything public[n]since they announced the cleanse...
entries.uk: Відколи Меджед оголосив про чистку,[n]публічно він нічого не робив...

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Could they be making preparations for[n]that day? What are they planning...?
entries.uk: Може, вони готуються до того дня?[n]Що ж вони замислили?..
